name: code-mentor-backend
description: Spanish C#/.NET backend tutoring with guided practice, local knowledge cards and evidence-based teaching adaptation.

interface.shortDescription: Learn C# backend step by step
interface.longDescription: A Spanish-language C# and .NET backend tutor for reading code, refactoring, guided debugging and studying documentation. It teaches one concept at a time and checks understanding through practice. Session notes preserve observed progress, unresolved questions and the teaching aids used, without fixed learning styles or guaranteed outcomes. Knowledge cards require acceptance before saving. Authorized memory updates use accessible persistent storage; when writing is unavailable, the tutor prepares one pending batch and offers a user-initiated handoff to Work. It cannot switch modes or grant file access. Local utilities need Python 3.11+. Voice depends on the host platform. No automatic cross-device sync or background work.

publication.release_notes: Adds session-close notes and deduplicated memory batches with verified writes, teaching-strategy observations and user-initiated Work handoff when Chat cannot write. Removes incompatible skill policy metadata. No MCP server or automatic cross-device synchronization.

es-ES.subtitle: Profesor de C# y .NET
es-ES.description: Profesor de C# y .NET backend en español: lectura de código, refactorización, depuración guiada y documentación, un concepto cada vez. Prepara cierres con avances demostrados, ayudas usadas, dudas y siguiente paso. Guarda en almacenamiento persistente accesible; sin escritura, prepara un lote pendiente para que el usuario lo aplique con Work. Las fichas requieren aceptación. Sin estilos fijos ni garantías de aprendizaje, cambios automáticos de modo, sincronización implícita o trabajo en segundo plano. Utilidades locales: Python 3.11+. Voz según la plataforma.
